data.title: Migrate docs/ into the journal as doc.written events
data.description: DEC-16 says documentation is an entity in the journal, not .md files, and the machinery has been done since KAD-34..38 - only the migration was never run. 66 files, 731 KB of prose, which becomes about 829 KB of events and takes .kadence/events from 200 KB to roughly 1.0 MB against the PRD's 5 MB budget. This is what creates the corpus kadence search will index: without it a fresh clone holds 11k tokens of prose instead of 194k. No special code - doc add --file already reads any path, so the migration runs the product on itself. docs/ stays on disk as the working draft; links are rewritten to DOC-N on publish, not in the draft, so the draft stays navigable in an editor and a republish is idempotent. The journal is append-only, so the events land untracked and are reviewed before anything is committed.
